description: Native deterministic health notices with persistent deduplication.

messages.invalid_health: Green health data is unavailable or invalid. Check the watcher data source.
messages.heartbeat_stale: Green's public health heartbeat is over 45 minutes old. The App or GitHub health delivery needs attention.
messages.local_silence: Green's local App health probe has been silent for over five minutes. Check App monitoring.
messages.paused: Green reports that the sync App is paused and needs attention.
messages.failed: Green reports a sync failure and needs attention.
messages.incident: Green reports an active incident. Check App status for details.
messages.inactive: Green reports that trial monitoring is inactive. Check App status.
messages.review_required: Green's first candidate appears ready for acceptance review. Publication remains held pending candidate and resource checks.
messages.first_success: Green has recorded its first successful sync. The native watcher remains active.
messages.recovery: Green health monitoring is reporting a healthy state again.
